europe_now.title: ICC condemns US sanctions as attack on judicial independence
europe_now.summary: The International Criminal Court has condemned US sanctions targeting its president and a senior prosecution lawyer, labeling them a 'flagrant attack' on judicial independence. EU institutions have opposed the measures, emphasizing their systemic threat to international legal frameworks.

europe_now.title: Ukraine conflict escalates with intensified Russian strikes
europe_now.summary: Russian strikes in Kyiv have killed at least 16 people amid severe air defense shortages, exacerbating the humanitarian crisis. Ukraine is grappling with defense reshuffling and ongoing attacks across multiple cities.

top_stories.title: ICC sanctions controversy
top_stories.summary: The ICC has criticized US sanctions as a deliberate assault on judicial autonomy, with the court's leadership facing targeted measures. EU institutions have united in opposing the sanctions, citing risks to global legal accountability.

top_stories.title: Ceuta migrant crisis
top_stories.summary: Spain has expanded temporary shelters in Ceuta to address the worsening humanitarian crisis caused by migrant influx. The situation has drawn criticism from Amnesty International, which demands an end to EU asylum outsourcing to Albania.
